import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'));sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
import repair_gmyhf_pending_answers as common
import upload_gmyhf_missing_data as uploader
from tests.test_gmyhf_missing_normal_data import load,oracle
work=Path('/tmp/gmyhf-missing-data-upload');initial=json.loads((work/'initial-normal-receipt.json').read_text())
s=common.platform.oj_submit.Session().login();groups=[]
for n in (29893,29894):
 before=next(g for g in initial['problems'] if g['global_number']==n);old={f['filename']:f['sha256'] for f in before['files']}
 directory=root/f'data/openjudge/tests/20000-29982/{n}_made/data';new={p.name:common.sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in directory.iterdir()}
 assert set(new)==set(old)
 gen=load(n)
 for p in directory.glob('*.in'):
  text=p.read_text();assert gen.valid(text) and oracle(n,text)+'\n'==p.with_suffix('.out').read_text()
 url=common.platform.oj_submit.HOST+f'/admin/problems/edit/?id={n}'
 def verify_form():
  page=s._get(url);fields=common.platform.parse_form(page)
  assert fields['problemId']==str(n) and uploader.fields_digest(fields)==before['baseline_form_sha256']
  assert set(common.listed_files(page,n))==set(old)
  assert all(fields.get(f'filenames[{name}]')=='1' for name in old)
 verify_form();changes=[]
 for name in sorted(old):
  current=common.sha(common.platform.download(s,n,name));assert current in (old[name],new[name]),(n,name,'出现第三种内容')
  if old[name]!=new[name]:changes.append({'filename':name,'before_sha256':old[name],'after_sha256':new[name]})
  if current!=new[name]:
   verify_form();common.platform.upload(s,n,name,(directory/name).read_bytes())
   assert common.sha(common.platform.download(s,n,name))==new[name]
 verify_form()
 for name in sorted(new):assert common.sha(common.platform.download(s,n,name))==new[name]
 groups.append({'global_number':n,'changes':changes,'all_files_readback_matched':True,'statement_limits_and_file_selection_unchanged':True})
 print(n,'边界构造修订',len(changes),'文件，全部42文件回读一致',flush=True)
report={'reason':'提交前按“有人上下车”复核，改用明确为正的第二站人数及n>=4，避免新数据落在题面歧义处；第0组样例保持。','groups':groups,'initial_receipt_sha256':common.sha((work/'initial-normal-receipt.json').read_bytes()),'procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
common.save(work/'train-candidate-boundary-revision.json',report)

import hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import upload_gmyhf_missing_data as uploader
import repair_gmyhf_pending_answers as common
normal=json.loads(Path('/tmp/gmyhf-missing-data-upload/normal-receipt.json').read_text())
bench=json.loads(Path('/tmp/gmyhf-missing-data-upload/benchmark-receipt.json').read_text())
assert len(normal['problems'])==6 and len(bench['problems'])==5
local=json.loads((root/'collab/gmyhf-missing-normal-local-proof.json').read_text())
assert len(local['entries'])==6 and all(e['local_judge']['status']=='Accepted' and e['cases']==21 for e in local['entries'])
for e in local['entries']:
 for name,digest in e['files_sha256'].items():assert common.sha((root/name).read_bytes())==digest,name
mut=json.loads((root/'collab/gmyhf-missing-data-mutations.json').read_text())
assert len(mut['results'])==20 and all(e['detected'] for e in mut['results'])
for name,digest in mut['restored_sources_sha256'].items():assert common.sha((root/name).read_bytes())==digest,name
baseline=json.loads((root/'collab/gmyhf-placeholder-exclusions.json').read_text())
old={e['global_number']:e for e in baseline['entries']}
s=common.platform.oj_submit.Session().login();verification=[]
for group in normal['problems']+bench['problems']:
 n=group['global_number'];assert group['applied'] and group['all_files_readback_matched'] and group['all_files_selected']
 page=s._get(common.platform.oj_submit.HOST+f'/admin/problems/edit/?id={n}');fields=common.platform.parse_form(page)
 assert fields['problemId']==str(n)
 assert uploader.fields_digest(fields)==old[n]['form_sha256']
 names={e['filename'] for e in group['files']};assert set(common.listed_files(page,n))==names
 assert all(fields.get(f'filenames[{name}]')=='1' for name in names)
 verification.append({'global_number':n,'pairs':group['pairs'],'file_count':len(names),'all_selected':True,'privacy':fields['privacy'],'statement_and_limits_unchanged':True,'limits':{key:fields[key] for key in ('timeLimit','caseTimeLimit','memoryLimit')}})
retired=[]
for n in (28979,31195,31248):
 page=s._get(common.platform.oj_submit.HOST+f'/admin/problems/edit/?id={n}')
 assert common.form_sha(page)==old[n]['form_sha256']
 assert not uploader.file_list(page,n);retired.append(n)
# 仅补测试文件，不新增公开镜像或课程题目；31381仍按上一批决定撤下。
sys.path.insert(0,str(root));from scripts.retire_gmyhf_31381 import course_mapping,EDIT_PATH
mapping=course_mapping(s._get(common.platform.oj_submit.HOST+EDIT_PATH))
prior=json.loads((root/'collab/gmyhf-spj-platform-retirement.json').read_text())
assert mapping==prior['after_mapping']
for name in ('data/openjudge/catalog.json','data/openjudge/test_index.json'):
 assert (root/name).read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+name]),name
catalog=json.loads((root/'data/openjudge/catalog.json').read_text())
new=set(uploader.NORMAL+uploader.BENCHMARK)
assert not any(int(e.get('global_number') or 0) in new and e.get('test_cases') for e in catalog['problems'])
bench_manifest=json.loads(Path('/tmp/gmyhf-missing-data-upload/benchmark-data/manifest.json').read_text())
paths=['scripts/gmyhf_io_benchmark_data.py','scripts/upload_gmyhf_missing_data.py','tests/test_gmyhf_missing_normal_data.py','tests/test_gmyhf_missing_data_upload.py','tests/test_gmyhf_io_benchmark_data.py','collab/gmyhf-missing-normal-local-proof.json','collab/gmyhf-missing-data-mutations.json']
report={'checked_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'用户要求为剩余11题补数据；只补平台测试文件与本地自产数据，不公开私有题面或新增课程绑定。','summary':{'problems_with_new_data':11,'normal_problems':6,'normal_pairs':126,'benchmark_problems':5,'benchmark_pairs':5,'total_new_pairs':131,'total_new_files':262,'remaining_without_downloads':retired,'statement_writes':0,'limit_changes':0,'course_changes':0,'new_public_catalog_entries':0,'local_accepted_pairs':126,'negative_probes_rejected':12,'mutation_count':20},'normal_upload':normal,'initial_normal_upload_receipt_sha256':common.sha(Path('/tmp/gmyhf-missing-data-upload/initial-normal-receipt.json').read_bytes()),'train_candidate_revision':json.loads(Path('/tmp/gmyhf-missing-data-upload/train-candidate-boundary-revision.json').read_text()),'benchmark_upload':bench,'benchmark_manifest':bench_manifest,'final_configuration_readback':verification,'local_data':{'normal_data':'六个*_made目录已入库，当前均无本地题库映射，使用原judge临时绑定已Accepted；未宣称本地已启用。','benchmarks':'完整约22MiB答案只存工作目录并上传平台，仓库保存生成器及哈希；本地继续按2MiB上限排除。'},'sample_interpretation':{'27207':'保留样例所有整数，补齐x=0的空前体行及末尾LF。','29337':'从两个混排的样例说明中提取实际输入输出；第0组为5个1/target3，另覆盖单个1/target1。','29893/29894':'去掉样例栏Markdown标题和围栏，保留5 7 32 4 -> 13。','31178':'只解码题面gzip/base64数据，不执行脚本，样例Hello, OJ Inject!原样输出。','31200':'只解码题面gzip/base64数据，不执行脚本，样例100 500 -> 153 370 371 407。'},'sources_sha256':{p:common.sha((root/p).read_bytes()) for p in paths},'procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(root/'collab/gmyhf-missing-data-completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report['summary'],ensure_ascii=False))
